text:
emily: Heads up  I'm planning to work from Santa Cruz, CA for ~6 weeks (2026-05-15 -> 2026-06-28). Quick questions: 1) WFH stipend proration? 2) CA withholding or nexus risk for a short stay? 3) Do I need to change my homebase? 4) Can IT ship a spare power brick to the Airbnb?
maria (people-ops): Nice! :sun_with_face: TL;DR: stipend is pro-rated by calendar days in the month; short visits don't usually create company tax nexus but state withholding can apply for wages earned in CA. Submit the Temp Remote form and mark "domestic".
emily: links? also my manager approved.
maria (people-ops): Temp Remote form: https://intra.redwood.com/peopleops/temp-remote. Homebase change only for permanent moves.
marc (payroll): We'll estimate proration and any CA withholding once form is in. For <90 days typically payroll will withhold CA state tax for days worked in CA; company-level nexus unlikely for one employee short stint. I've opened PR-5301.
samir (legal): Confirming payroll note. Legal: short term is low nexus risk, but if multiple employees travel to the same state repeatedly it can increase exposure. Keep travel records.
emily: Address I'll put on the form:
```nEmily Cho
Airbnb - 78 Seacliff Ave Apt B
Santa Cruz, CA 95060
Dates: 2026-05-15 - 2026-06-28
```nIs that enough for IT?
jason (it): That works for a power brick. We need signed equipment waiver for any device. For small accessories just check the shipping box on the temp form and i'll process. ETA 2-5 business days.
payroll-bot: PR-5301 created  payroll will post estimated stipend proration and withholding delta within 48 hours.
emily: Submitted form and checked shipping. Waiver signed.
marc (payroll): Preliminary numbers: May stipend pro-rate = $90.00, June full stipend = $300.00. Estimated CA withholding delta small (~$22) for June pay period; final after payroll calc.
maria (people-ops): Thanks everyone. Emily, enjoy the coast! DM if you need local office or coworking recs.
emily: Thanks all :beach_with_umbrella:
